chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUdhāfir, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

When you arrive in Makkah on the Day of Tarwiyah while you are performing tamattuʿ, then you have the time between your arrival and the night to perform tawaf of the House, perform saʿy, and make it a mutʿah.

key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: nightfall, the legal deadline mentioned in this report
key_terms.تَسْعَى: to perform saʿy between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.تَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ: to perform tawaf around the Kaʿbah
key_terms.مُتْعَةً: tamattuʿ, the form of pilgrimage being validated here
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah, a key time marker in hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Until what time can a pilgrim still complete Hajj al-tamattuʿ if arriving in Makkah on the Day of Tarwiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the time in which a pilgrim may still complete tamattuʿ upon arriving in Makkah on the Day of Tarwiyah. It indicates that the pilgrim may perform tawaf and saʿy before nightfall and thereby count the rite as tamattuʿ.
